text.text_excerpt: Months ago I read an article on Nola.com about this restaurant and I made up in my mind that I had to try it. I finally made my way in. The space is beautiful. It's in the former Hookah House. Has two bars, upstairs and downstairs. The bartender downstairs, Daytona, was super sweet, cheery, and helpful. I also spoke with the owner, My My, for a while and she's super nice. Her passion is obvious and she is really putting a ton of time and care into this restaurant. I came in on a Friday night and there was a good little crowd. There was a DJ upstairs playing great music. I was singing along the whole time. l ordered two appetizers: the wing dings and the jerk rolls. I got the wing dings wi...

Now I will say I was fairly pleased with not only the food here but the very welcoming & accommodating staff. Great experience all around. The bartender was was absolutely astounding with her very upbeat personality. Made my visit much more pleasant for sure. The food here was amazing. I opted for the OxTail as I have never tried it and I now see what the rave is all about. The dish was beyond plentiful and had quick a kick to it that damn near brought me to tears. I also had the side of collard greens which were amazingly cooked. They have Carrabien food infused with New Orleans traditional soul food. The food was very flavorful with a little kick. It's also a plus they have late hours t...

I was recommended to go to this new restaurant and I must say that they did not disappoint! We came late on a night where they really were about to close but we would have not known We were welcomed in...got told about all the entrees and were told to take our time...The jerk chicken appetizer was so delish!! The jerk chicken dinner portion was a great portion and we will enjoy the rest later in our to go container we took with us! This new spot is a great gem on Magazine Street and I will definitely visit again in my travels to New Orleans.
